intro: The Gnoam Sprecklesprocket is a sophisticated power supply salvaged from Sneed's shredder deep within the Deadmines. Gnomish engineers seek this component to supercharge specialized drilling machines in an ambitious bid to reclaim their fallen home of Gnomeregan.

p: Found in a goblin shredder operated within the Defias stronghold, the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket represents an exceptional feat of compact mechanical energy. Operating deep in the lumbering machine piloted by the goblin taskmaster Sneed, this specialized core delivers enough sustained energy to drive heavy industrial logging and cutting blades. Its stability and potent output make it an invaluable piece of salvage amidst the subterranean tunnels of Westfall.

In Stormwind City, the gnomish inventor Shoni the Shilent singled out the Deadmines shredder as the key to a larger offensive. Gnomish forces seek to reclaim Gnomeregan from the trogg hordes that overran it, but the sealed underground approaches present a formidable barrier. By harnessing the Sprecklesprocket, Shoni intends to power heavy gyrodrillmatic excavationators capable of boring directly through the solid bedrock surrounding the lost techno-city, establishing an unexpected underground assault route.
